title: Diaspor Score Record v1
description: Forward-looking JSON Schema for the score records that the diaspor-vision + diaspor-events pipeline will emit per analyzed time window of a media stream. Score records describe a stream window (stream_id + tenant + [t_start_ms, t_end_ms]); they are distinct from sidecar records (which describe a file's transcript + tags — see sidecar-v1.json). Both schemas may be persisted into the same VFS but at different paths: sidecars at /.index/<file>.json, scores at /.streams/<stream_id>/windows/<timestamp>.score.json (with threshold-crossing events at /.streams/<stream_id>/events/<timestamp>.event.json reusing this same shape). v1 is published in advance of the M7 milestone so that downstream tooling can target a stable shape from the v0.1.0-alpha.1 release onward. The corresponding in-memory Rust types live in `crates/diaspor-vision/src/record.rs` and `crates/diaspor-events/src/event.rs`.

schema_version.description: Schema version constant. v1 records always carry the literal string "1".

stream_id.description: Opaque, tenant-unique identifier for the stream being analyzed. For batch uploads, the stream_id is derived from the file's content hash. For live ingest (WHIP, meeting-bot, HLS), the stream_id is allocated at session start.

tenant.description: Opaque tenant identifier the stream belongs to. Routing key for per-tenant LoRA adapter selection and for VFS sidecar placement (sinks namespace by tenant).

t_start_ms.description: Inclusive lower bound of the analyzed time window, in milliseconds from the start of the stream.

t_end_ms.description: Exclusive upper bound of the analyzed time window, in milliseconds from the start of the stream. Must be > t_start_ms.

kind.description: Whether this record represents a periodic window aggregate or a single threshold-crossing event. Defaults to "window" if absent.

extracted_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp of when the record was finalized. Must include a timezone offset (`Z` for UTC).

model_provenance.description: Optional array of model-provenance records, one per modality that contributed to this score. Useful for reproducing and auditing results. The shape of each entry matches the ModelProvenance definition in sidecar-v1.json.

Modalities.description: Per-modality outputs. Each key is optional — a window record may carry only a subset (for example, pose-only for sport judging, or face+prosody for credibility). At least one modality must be present.

PoseModality.description: 33-keypoint 3D body pose output. Topology matches MediaPipe BlazePose 3D.

model.description: Identifier of the pose model used, e.g. "diaspor-pose-3d-v1".

keypoints.description: Array of 33 keypoints in BlazePose topology order. Each keypoint is { x, y, z, visibility } where x/y are normalized [0,1], z is normalized depth, and visibility ∈ [0,1].

joint_angles_deg.description: Optional joint-angle measurements in degrees, keyed by joint name (e.g. "left_elbow", "right_knee").

velocity_mps.description: Optional per-keypoint velocity in normalized units per second. Same length and order as `keypoints`.

FaceModality.description: 478-landmark facial geometry output. Topology matches MediaPipe FaceMesh.

model.description: Identifier of the face-mesh model, e.g. "diaspor-face-mesh-v1".

landmarks_quantized.description: Base64-encoded INT8 quantization of the 478 landmark (x,y,z) triples. Encoding: 478 × 3 × 1 byte = 1434 bytes; landmark_i_axis = (byte_i - 128) / 127.0 → normalized [-1,1]. Quantized to keep JSON payload small; full-precision floats available in the binary sidecar.

microexpr.description: Optional Facial Action Unit intensities, keyed by AU code (e.g. "AU4" = brow lowerer). Values in [0,1].

gaze.description: Optional gaze direction { yaw_deg, pitch_deg } in degrees relative to head pose.

ProsodyModality.description: Vocal prosody feature extractor output. Default backend: openSMILE eGeMAPSv02 + ComParE2016.

model.description: Identifier of the prosody extractor, e.g. "diaspor-prosody-v1".

tremor_index.description: Composite tremor indicator in [0,1]. Derived from jitter and shimmer features.

f0_var.description: Variance of fundamental frequency (Hz²) over the window.

pace_words_per_minute.description: Estimated speaking rate over the window.

features_dim.description: Dimensionality of the full feature vector emitted alongside this summary record. For eGeMAPSv02 + ComParE2016 deduped, expect 6552.

CredibilityModality.description: Composite credibility-signal output. NOT a lie-detection verdict — a per-window indicator of stress + incongruence with disclosed accuracy ceiling and human baseline. Forensic, legal, hiring, insurance, and law-enforcement adjudication use cases are out of scope and refused at the API layer. EU workplace and education contexts are blocked under the EU AI Act (Aug 2026).

model.description: Identifier of the credibility model, e.g. "diaspor-credibility-v1".

score.description: Indicator score in [0,1]. Higher means more stress/incongruence signal present. Not a probability of deception.

confidence_band.description: Calibrated uncertainty bucket for the score. Consumers should display this prominently next to the score.

human_baseline_disclosed.description: The human baseline accuracy for video-based deception inference, disclosed alongside every credibility score for honesty. Approximately 0.54 (peer-reviewed meta-analysis).

ceiling_disclosed.description: The accuracy ceiling for video-based deception inference in the peer-reviewed literature, disclosed alongside every credibility score. Approximately 0.74.

labs_preview.description: True if the model is still in private beta (Labs preview). Consumers should clearly label the score as preview-quality.

vertical_attestation.description: Vertical declared by the tenant at API-key creation time. Used by the API layer to refuse forbidden verticals before invoking the model. Recorded here for audit.

JudgeModality.description: Sport-judging score output. Per-discipline model fine-tuned on the discipline's reference rubric.

model.description: Identifier of the judge model, e.g. "diaspor-judge-v1".

discipline.description: Sport discipline this score applies to. Diving first, then weightlifting / martial-arts forms / gymnastics.

score.description: Discipline-specific score on the rubric's native scale. Diving: typically [0, 30] for execution * difficulty.

execution_score.description: Optional execution-only sub-score on the rubric's native scale.

difficulty_multiplier.description: Optional difficulty multiplier (degree of difficulty), where applicable.

rubric_version.description: Identifier of the discipline rubric the model was calibrated against (e.g. "fina-2025", "fig-2025").

z.description: Normalized depth (negative is closer to the camera).

visibility.description: Visibility score in [0,1]; lower indicates occluded or out-of-frame.

ModelProvenance.description: Structured record of which exact model produced one modality's output. Same shape as sidecar-v1's ModelProvenance for cross-schema consistency.

model_hash.description: Optional cryptographic hash of the model file (hex-encoded SHA-256 by convention).

adapter_id.description: Optional per-tenant LoRA adapter identifier active for this inference. Present only for custom-tier deployments.

runtime.description: Inference backend that ran the model, e.g. "triton", "coreml", "ort-cpu".

latency_us.description: End-to-end inference latency for this modality in microseconds.
